{{Short description|Football match in Rome, Italy}} {{Infobox football match | title = 2026 Coppa Italia final | other_titles = 78th Coppa Italia Final | image = L'Olimpico - panoramio.jpg | alt = | event = [[2025–26 Coppa Italia]] | caption = The [[Stadio Olimpico]] in [[Rome]] hosted the final | team1 = [[SS Lazio|Lazio]] | team1score = 0 | team2 = [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]] | team2score = 2 | details = | date = {{Start date|2026|5|13|df=y}} | stadium = [[Stadio Olimpico]] | city = [[Rome]] | man_of_the_match1a = [[Denzel Dumfries]] (Internazionale){{cite web|url=https://www.legaseriea.it/coppa-italia/news/lazio-inter-risultato-gol-diretta-finale-coppa-italia-frecciarossa-13-05-2026-roma-stadio-olimpico|title=Lazio-Inter, la Coppa Italia Frecciarossa 2026 è dell'Inter|language=it|publisher=Lega Serie A|date=13 May 2026|access-date=14 May 2026}} | referee = [[Marco Guida]]{{cite web|url=https://www.aia-figc.it/news/coppa-italia-frecciarossa-designazioni-finale-27379/|title=Coppa Italia Frecciarossa – Designazione finale|language=it|website=aia-figc.it|date=11 May 2026|access-date=12 May 2026}} {{Dead link|date=October 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }} | attendance = 68,729 | weather = | previous = [[2025 Coppa Italia final|2025]] | next = ''2027'' }} The '''2026 Coppa Italia final''' was the last match of the [[2025–26 Coppa Italia|2025–26 edition]] of the [[Coppa Italia]], Italy's premier national football cup. It was played on 13 May 2026 between [[SS Lazio|Lazio]] and [[Inter Milan]] in a repeat of the [[2000 Coppa Italia final]], which Lazio won over [[Two-legged tie|two legs]], and the [[1998 UEFA Cup final|first single-leg UEFA Cup final two years prior]], which Inter won. == Background == Lazio had previously played in ten Coppa Italia finals, winning seven times. Their most recent final appearance was in [[2019 Coppa Italia final|2019]], defeating Atalanta in [[Rome]]. Inter had won nine of their 15 previous appearances in the cup final. Their most recent appearance was victory over [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]] in [[2023 Coppa Italia final|2023]].{{cite web |last1=Campanale |first1=Susy |title=Coppa Italia Final will be Inter vs. Lazio on May 13 |url=https://football-italia.net/coppa-italia-final-inter-vs-lazio-on-may-13/ |website=Football-Italia |date=22 April 2026}} The two teams had met once before in the [[2000 Coppa Italia final]], where Lazio won over two legs to achieve its first and only [[Double (association football)|double]].{{cite web |last1=Cavaleri |first1=Giada |title=Finali tra Inter e Lazio: dalla Coppa UEFA al "double" del 2000 |url=https://11contro11.it/finali-inter-lazio/ |website=11contro11 |language=it-IT |date=24 April 2026 |trans-title=Inter-Lazio Finals: From the UEFA Cup to the 2000 Double}} In reaching the final, both teams qualified for the [[2026–27 Supercoppa Italiana]]. ==Road to the final== ''Note: In all results below, the score of the finalist is given first (H: home; A: away).'' {| width="100%" style="text-align:center" |- valign=top bgcolor=#99ccff !colspan=2 style="width:40%"|[[SS Lazio|Lazio]] !
